decisions.reason: As the flagship platform built directly on our core hosting, automation, and service capabilities, it fits our absorptive capacity best and remains central to our strategic direction.

This configurable managed hosting plan is still close to our established knowledge base and can be improved through internal learning, but it is more exposed to portfolio simplification or integration into broader offers than the flagship products.

Extended PHP security support draws strongly on our existing technical support, security, and compliance know-how, and although it is newer and has less market evidence, it aligns well with our current development path.
